note: Working values chosen to have something to measure against, pending the numbers BeEyes / the LAC group actually need. Change them here; every value says why it was picked.

confirm_latency_s.unit: seconds with the target in view, from first sighting to a confirmed report
confirm_latency_s.why: An operator deciding whether to send a ground team should not wait longer than half a minute of looking. Measured on flight 3: first-to-last-span maturity takes 52 s; looks >= 20 takes 22 s.

false_confirmations_per_hour.unit: confirmed reports that are not the target, per hour of flight
false_confirmations_per_hour.why: One false alarm every ten minutes is a crop an operator can check without learning to ignore the alerts.

radius_95_max_m.unit: metres, radius of the reported 95 % circle
radius_95_max_m.why: A circle a ground team can search on foot in a minute or two. Measured: about 5 m, set by GPS and heading bias.

radius_coverage_min.unit: fraction of confirmed true targets whose true position lies inside the reported radius
radius_coverage_min.why: A 95 % circle that holds the truth less often than that is lying to the ground team.

sweep_find_rate_60s_min.unit: fraction of 60 s passes with the target in view that confirm it
sweep_find_rate_60s_min.why: A search that crosses a person for a minute and stays silent most of the time is not a search. Measured: span maturity 47 %.

crop_on_every_report.why: No on-board signal separates a person from an object the detector confuses with one; the operator needs the photograph to decide.
